title: The Man Who Called His Son's Name | Ajamila
sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 6, chapters 1-3 (Ajamila's fall, his son Narayana, the Yamadutas, the Vishnudutas, the discussion of the holy name, Ajamila's repentance and Haridwar).

lines.text: He said one word at the end of his life. And it saved him.
lines.caps: One *word | at the *end of his life. | It *saved him.

lines.text: Ajamila was a learned Brahmin who followed every rule. Then he fell into bad company and gave up his duties.
lines.caps: A *learned Brahmin | fell into *bad company | and gave up his *duties.

lines.text: He lived that way for years. His youngest son was his favorite, a little boy named Narayana.
lines.caps: His favorite was his *youngest son, | a little boy named *Narayana.

lines.text: At the end of his life, three terrifying Yamadutas came for him.
lines.caps: At the end, three *Yamadutas | came for *him.

lines.text: Terrified, he called out for his child: Narayana!
But Narayana is also a name of Vishnu. His attendants appeared at once.
lines.caps: But *Narayana | is also a name of *Vishnu. | His attendants *appeared.

lines.text: They stopped the Yamadutas. You cannot take him. He has called that name.
lines.caps: *You cannot take him. | He called *that name.

lines.text: The Yamadutas asked how a sinner could be spared. The Vishnudutas explained the power of the holy name.
lines.caps: How can a *sinner be spared? | The *holy name | has *power.

lines.text: Ajamila heard everything. He felt deep regret for the life he had lived.
lines.caps: He heard it *all. | He felt deep *regret.

lines.text: He went to Haridwar, gave up everything, and spent the rest of his life in devotion. At the end, he reached the abode of Vishnu.
lines.caps: He went to *Haridwar. | A life of *devotion. | At the end, *Vishnu's abode.

lines.text: It is never too late to turn toward the good. Follow for more stories.
lines.caps: Never too *late | to turn toward the *good. | Follow for *more stories.
